descriptor: An AI-powered operating system for small Nigerian businesses, focusing on deterministic financial calculations and AI-driven insights.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to record transactions via text, voice, or manual form.
The system must validate structured transaction data before writing to the database.
The system must provide a dashboard displaying today's sales, expenses, estimated profit, customer debts, and low-stock products.
The system must use PostgreSQL as the database for storing business data.
The system must use the Anthropic Claude API for AI functionalities.
The system must provide inventory management with details on product quantity, buying price, selling price, profit margin, reorder level, and supplier.
The system must allow users to query AI for business insights using actual database data.
The system must ensure tenant isolation for all business data records.
The system must provide customer debt management with reminders for overdue payments.
The system must log all AI actions for audit purposes.
The system must support multi-tenant architecture.
The system must provide a mobile-first responsive UI.
The system must use WhatsApp Business API for messaging integration.
The system must provide AI-driven daily business briefings to users.
The system must ensure all financial calculations are performed server-side.
The system must support voice transaction entry using a speech-to-text provider.
The system must provide configurable automation for sending customer debt reminders.
The system must provide AI-driven inventory recommendations based on sales data.

releases.demo: Record a transaction via text and display it on the dashboard with validated data stored in PostgreSQL.
releases.goal: Establish core transaction recording and dashboard functionality with secure data handling.
releases.name: Foundation and Core Features

releases.demo: Manage inventory levels and send customer debt reminders with AI assistance.
releases.goal: Introduce inventory management and customer debt features.
releases.name: Enhanced Inventory and Customer Management

releases.demo: Query AI for business insights and record a transaction via voice input.
releases.goal: Enable AI-driven business insights and voice transaction entry.
releases.name: AI Business Insights and Voice Entry

releases.demo: Receive a daily business briefing with AI-generated insights and recommendations.
releases.goal: Implement AI Business Manager and daily business briefings.
releases.name: AI Business Manager and Daily Briefings

releases.demo: Send automated debt reminders via WhatsApp and configure automation settings.
releases.goal: Integrate WhatsApp messaging and introduce automation for debt reminders.
releases.name: Messaging and Automation

stories.title: Record Transaction via Text
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to record transactions via text, so that I can easily update my business records.
acceptance: Given a text input for a transaction, When the text is submitted, Then the transaction is recorded in the database.
Given an invalid transaction text, When the text is submitted, Then the system prompts for correction.
Trust: The transaction is logged with a timestamp and user ID.
stories.task_guidance: Implement text input processing and validation for transactions, storing results in the 'transactions' table.

stories.title: Display Dashboard Metrics
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to view dashboard metrics, so that I can monitor business performance.
acceptance: Given the user is logged in, when they access the dashboard, then they see the latest metrics.
Given the user is not logged in, when they attempt to access the dashboard, then they are prompted to log in.
Trust: All dashboard accesses are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the dashboard using the existing UI framework, ensuring metrics are fetched from the analytics service.

stories.title: Manage Inventory Levels
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to manage my inventory levels, so that I can ensure stock availability and profitability.
acceptance: Given a product inventory, When a sale is recorded, Then the inventory level is updated accordingly.
Given a low-stock alert, When the inventory is checked, Then the system suggests reorder actions.
Trust: Inventory changes are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Implement inventory tracking and alerts using the 'inventory_movements' and 'products' tables.

stories.title: Send Customer Debt Reminders
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to send reminders to customers with overdue debts, so that I can improve cash flow.
acceptance: Given a list of overdue debts, When reminders are sent, Then customers receive notifications via the chosen channel.
Given a debt below the reminder threshold, When reminders are sent, Then no notification is sent for that debt.
Trust: All reminder actions are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the reminder system using the 'customer_debts' and 'notifications' tables.

stories.title: Query AI for Business Insights
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to query AI for business insights, so that I can make informed decisions.
acceptance: Given a business query, When the AI is queried, Then it provides insights based on actual data.
Given insufficient data for a query, When the AI is queried, Then it informs the user of the data gap.
Trust: All AI queries and responses are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate AI query handling using the Anthropic Claude API and 'analytics' table.

stories.title: Record Transaction via Voice
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to record transactions via voice, so that I can update records hands-free.
acceptance: Given a voice input for a transaction, When the input is processed, Then the transaction is recorded in the database.
Given an unclear voice input, When the input is processed, Then the system prompts for clarification.
Trust: Voice transactions are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Implement voice-to-text processing and transaction validation using a speech-to-text provider.

stories.title: Receive AI Daily Business Briefing
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to receive a daily business briefing, so that I can stay informed about my business performance.
acceptance: Given a new day, When the briefing is generated, Then it includes sales, profit, and debt information.
Given incomplete data, When the briefing is generated, Then it highlights missing information.
Trust: Briefing generation is logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the daily briefing system using the 'analytics' and 'notifications' tables.

stories.title: Implement AI Business Manager Tools
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want AI to manage business tools, so that I can automate routine tasks.
acceptance: Given a business task, When AI tools are used, Then the task is completed using actual data.
Given insufficient data for a task, When AI tools are used, Then it informs the user of the data gap.
Trust: All AI tool actions are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Implement AI tool integration using the Anthropic Claude API and 'business_tools' table.

stories.title: Send Notifications via WhatsApp
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want to send notifications via WhatsApp, so that I can keep customers informed through their preferred messaging platform.
acceptance: Given a customer with a registered WhatsApp number, when a notification is triggered, then the system sends a WhatsApp message to the customer.
Given a customer without a registered WhatsApp number, when a notification is triggered, then the system logs a failure to send the message.
Trust: All sent messages are logged with tenant isolation for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement WhatsApp messaging using the existing notification service. Ensure tenant isolation by tagging messages with tenant IDs in the logs.

stories.title: Configure Automation for Debt Reminders
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want to configure automation for debt reminders, so that I can streamline my debt collection process.
acceptance: Given a debt reminder configuration, When saved, Then reminders are sent automatically based on the settings.
Given an incorrect configuration, When saved, Then the system prompts for correction.
Trust: All automation configurations are logged with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Develop automation configuration using the 'customer_debts' and 'automation_settings' tables.

stories.title: Ensure Tenant Isolation for Business Data
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to ensure tenant isolation for all business data records, so that data privacy and security are maintained.
acceptance: Given a multi-tenant environment, when data is accessed, then the system ensures that only data belonging to the tenant is accessible.
Given a request for data from a different tenant, when the request is made, then the system denies access and logs the attempt.
Trust: All data access attempts are logged with tenant identifiers for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data access controls and logging to ensure tenant isolation. Use tenant IDs to segregate data access.

stories.title: Log AI Actions for Audit
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want all AI actions to be logged, so that I can audit the system's AI decisions and actions.
acceptance: Given an AI action is performed, when the action is completed, then the system logs the action with details.
Given an AI action fails, when the failure occurs, then the system logs the failure with error details.
Trust: All AI actions are logged with timestamps and user identifiers for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for AI actions in the system. Ensure logs include action details, timestamps, and user IDs.

stories.title: Provide Mobile-First Responsive UI
stories.narrative: As a mobile user, I want a mobile-first responsive UI, so that I can access the system effectively on my mobile device.
acceptance: Given a mobile device, when accessing the system, then the UI adjusts to fit the screen size and orientation.
Given a desktop device, when accessing the system, then the UI provides an optimal layout for larger screens.
Trust: UI responsiveness is logged with device type and screen resolution for audit purposes.
failure_paths: Slow UI response on device rotation
stories.task_guidance: Design and implement a responsive UI using CSS frameworks. Test on various devices and screen sizes.

stories.title: Perform Financial Calculations Server-Side
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want all financial calculations to be performed server-side, so that I can ensure accuracy and security of financial data.
acceptance: Given a financial transaction, when calculations are required, then the system performs them server-side and returns the result.
Given a client-side calculation request, when the request is made, then the system denies it and logs the attempt.
Trust: All financial calculations are logged with transaction IDs for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement server-side logic for financial calculations. Ensure client-side requests are redirected to the server.

The system must log all AI actions for audit purposes.
The system must ensure all financial calculations are performed server-side.
